subject: Renewal approaching — benchmark request & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Michael Peterson <michael@edenway.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Edenway Procurement <procurement@edenway.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal and performance validation request

Diego —

Our renewal window with Redwood is up in 6 weeks and procurement is pressing for concrete evidence that Redwood can hit the throughput and tail-latency numbers our engineering team requires. We've had a competitive outreach (unnamed vendor) that claims 30% lower per-token cost and a 2x sustained throughput improvement on similar workloads. Before we go down that path we'd like to run a short, side-by-side bakeoff and get a clear mutual action plan.

Specifically: can you share a proposed validation plan (what we run, sample prompts, duration) and an indication of a temporary capacity uplift during the trial? Procurement will also want to see an updated term sheet if we decide to extend. I've attached our initial ask (edenway_request_v1.pdf) with the workload snapshot and SLA expectations.

Can we set a 30-minute call today to align?

Thanks,
Michael Peterson
CTO, Edenway

Attachment: edenway_request_v1.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Peterson <michael@edenway.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and performance validation request

Michael —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the workload snapshot. We absolutely want to avoid a disruptive replatform for you and are prepared to move quickly. High level proposal:

- Two-week side-by-side bakeoff with a 48-72 hour sustained throughput window (we align on dataset + query distribution)
- One-time capacity uplift of +40% GPU headroom for the validation window (no long-term commit required)
- Defined pass/fail SLOs for P50/P95 token latencies and cost-per-1k tokens delta
- Dedicated on-call from our infra team for the duration, plus a joint retrospective and data handoff

Marissa — can you confirm pricing flexibility for a short-term uplift and whether we can offer an interim term amendment that keeps their current T&Cs but adds the trial capacity? Karthik — please flag any ops constraints or preflight checks; I want a bakeoff plan and quick checklist we can push to Edenway today.

I can hop on a quick sync at 11:30 PT.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Michael Peterson <michael@edenway.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and performance validation request

Michael —

We appreciate you sharing the snapshot. Quick commercial options we can offer while the bakeoff runs: 

- Interim capacity uplift pricing: +40% capacity for 2 weeks at a 10% uplift to current rate (waived if they sign a 12-month renewal within 30 days)
- If the bakeoff shows parity on latency but >15% cost advantage to the competitor, we'll offer a one-time credit that offsets the net difference for 3 months
- We can also include a pro-rated additional support SLA (faster incident response) for the trial window

I'll prepare an interim amendment and the commercial language for Diego to share. For the bakeoff, please confirm the traffic slice you want us to mirror (sample size and peak concurrency).

—Marissa
Director, Renewal & Expansion
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Peterson <michael@edenway.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Edenway Procurement <procurement@edenway.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and performance validation request

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks — that all sounds sensible. A couple of clarifications from our infra team:

- We'll share a 72-hour peak window log and a 24-hour baseline (attached in our first doc). For the bakeoff we want to run their standard production prompt set plus a heavy tail of caching-busting queries (approx 15% of traffic) to replicate our worst-case behavior.
- We need the capacity uplift to be available starting Monday, March 15th and run two weeks (Mar 15–29). Can you guarantee no throttling during the sustained window?
- Competitor claimed numbers: 35% throughput improvement at same GPU tier; we expect Redwood to either show parity or provide a clear migration deferral plan.

Procurement will only sign an amendment if the trial window is instrumented and there's a DocuSign-ready term amendment including the uplift pricing and the 30-day conversion incentive Marissa mentioned.

I'll take the 11:30 sync — sending calendar invite now.

Michael
CTO, Edenway
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Peterson <michael@edenway.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Edenway Procurement <procurement@edenway.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and performance validation request

Michael —

Great sync earlier — attached is the bakeoff plan and the operational checklist we agreed on. Key next steps summarized: 

1) Redwood to provision +40% GPU headroom in the us-west region starting 2026-03-15 00:00 PT through 2026-03-29 23:59 PT. No throttling for trial traffic; isolated pool with prefix cache disabled for the tail test.
2) Joint validation tests: baseline run (24h), peak stress (72h), and final 6-hour verification window. Pass criteria defined in sheet (P95 <= 250ms, P99 <= 650ms for the sampled set; cost delta <= 10% vs current)
3) Commercials: interim amendment (attached) with uplift pricing (10%) and a 30-day conversion credit if they sign a 12-month renewal. DocuSign link will be sent by Marissa once procurement confirms.
4) Ops: Karthik is on-call for the trial; contact details in the checklist. We'll also capture token-level cost telemetry and provide a joint dashboard (link below) for live monitoring.

Attachments: redwood_bakeoff_plan.xlsx, canary_config.json

Related link: https://redwood.app/jira/RED-7842 (bakeoff ticket)
DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC1234

If all good I'll lock provisioning and send the interim amendment to procurement later today.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192
